verdict.rationale: Alma has at least one country-targeted founder page (the 'best-visa-options-startup-founders-india' learn article) and nationality-gated visa pages such as TN for Canadian and Mexican citizens and E-2 for treaty-country entrepreneurs. That shows some origin-country-specific guidance, but its depth and breadth are thin. Missing for 10: consulate processing guidance, country-specific backlog or visa-bulletin content, evidence of dedicated pages for founders from more than one country, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country

citations.quote: Alma's immigration legal services help founders identify and execute optimal visa strategies with a 99%+ approval rate.
